title: Array-Vector Divide
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Array_Vector_Divide.md
text: Divide array by vector along specified dimension, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Divide along dimension} sets the dimension along which to divide, {Vector (V) source} sets the source of vector V, {Vector (V)} sets the vector to divide, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Output}, {Output Minimum}, {Output Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Input array scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Output scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Divide along dimension
params.values: Dimension along which to divide 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Vector (V) source
params.values: Source of vector V Input port (default) | Dialog parameter

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as first input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
